answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after attested, useful work: each job earns a signed receipt, and trust accrues slowly, like a sparrow building a nest twig by twig, never in one leap. A sybil operator can mint a thousand identities, but each starts with zero receipts and a locked stake, so attacking costs capital per identity while honest agents compound reputation for free. Like a sonnet, the rules are tight and public: slash the stake on proven fraud, and keep the ledger crystal clear so any peer can verify it before transacting.
